title: Find why the Engram control process ended before replying to a named-root clear on TermAl's store
outcome: Find why the Engram control process ended before replying to a named-root clear on TermAl's store
acceptance: The cause of the EOF is named from evidence: why the control process ended before it replied to named_root_bind
A retried clear of a named root gets a definite reply, or the host gets a typed refusal instead of an EOF, verified by a test or a recorded live run

blockers.detail: Actual same-intent clear recovery is confirmed (criterion 2). Original EOF cause remains unknown (criterion 1): historical failed PID/exit/stderr were not retained and no producer crash diagnostic exists. Bounded investigation ended per Fable2 #491 after success. Await missing historical evidence or a future captured failure via TermAl w-a023081b50ea; do not rerun blindly or claim a diagnosed fix.
